en.headline: Tuen Mun Hospital opens neuroscience centre for integrated care
en.dek: The centre co-locates wards, operating theatres and rehabilitation on one floor, introducing advanced technologies including magnetic resonance-guided focused ultrasound.
body: The opening ceremony of the Tuen Mun Hospital Neuroscience Centre was held on Friday. The centre provides multidisciplinary, integrated treatment and rehabilitation for patients with neurological conditions such as acute stroke, movement disorders and epilepsy.

Facilities including the integrated neuroscience ward with 44 beds, advanced operating theatres and rehabilitation areas are located on the same floor to facilitate cross-specialty collaboration. The centre has introduced Hong Kong's first magnetic resonance-guided focused ultrasound and intraoperative magnetic resonance imaging services.

Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau attended the ceremony. Hospital officials said the co-location design aims to shorten treatment times and reduce the need for patients to move between departments. Phased services began at the end of 2024.

zh.headline: 屯門醫院神經醫學中心開幕 提供跨專科綜合服務
zh.dek: 中心將病房、手術室及復康設施集中同一樓層，並引入磁波刀及術中磁力共振等先進科技。
body: 屯門醫院神經醫學中心周五舉行開幕典禮。中心為急性中風、運動障礙及腦癫等腦神經系統疾病病人提供跨專科綜合治療及復康服務。
綜合病房設有44張病床，連同先進手術室及復康設施同層設置，方便跨專科協作。中心引入全港首個磁波刀治療及術中磁力共振掃描服務。
醫務衛生局局長盧寵茂出席典禮。院方表示，同層設計有助縮短治療時間及減少病人轉介轉移。服務自2024底分階段投入運作。
